title: BreakCurl bounded IDOR fixture contract
description: For two owned disposable actors and private objects. Replace example canaries with independent random values already seeded in private fields. A true declaration is supplied by the fixture author, not inferred by BreakCurl.

authModel.description: Bearer is the only identity and authority source; path and transport supply no extra access.

objectIdsGrantAccess.description: Object IDs are not capabilities, signed credentials or access grants.

rule.description: Actor A must not read object B; the fixture has no shared/public access.

privateCanaries.description: Both markers were independently generated and seeded in private fields, are not derived from IDs, and cannot occur in public or reflected inputs.

url.description: Fixed identity endpoint such as /me, on the same origin; no query, fragment, userinfo or redirects.

pathTemplate.description: Absolute path with exactly one whole {objectId} segment, e.g. /objects/{objectId}. All other segments must be identical literal unencoded path segments.

pointer.description: Non-root RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; exact string equality is required.

canary.description: Independently seeded private random marker, distinct for each object, never present in any prepared request. It is discarded from responses and reports.
